summary: Verified MongoDB Atlas runtime switch: teacher login succeeds, dashboard renders authenticated content, and invalid credentials remain rejected. 2/2 browser checks passed, 0 failed.

checks.criterion: Teacher can authenticate through the public app after the MongoDB Atlas runtime switch (and dashboard data is available)
checks.name: teacher-login-dashboard
checks.evidence: Navigated to /auth, filled email-input/password-input with teacher@vidya.com/teacher123, clicked auth-submit. URL left /auth, page rendered 'Demo Teacher' identity text confirming authenticated dashboard state. No thrown errors.

checks.name: login-rejects-invalid-credentials
checks.evidence: Submitted teacher@vidya.com/wrongpassword via auth-submit. Backend responded 401 (visible as console network error, matching seed fact). Page stayed on /auth and displayed an error/invalid message; no authenticated view entered.
